rationale: Frequent prolactin-driven or sexual-dysfunction-driven switch. Plateau cross-taper because risperidone's full D2 antagonism interacts with aripiprazole's partial agonism — abrupt aripiprazole introduction can produce paradoxical worsening or akathisia. Slow risperidone reduction after aripiprazole stabilisation. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start aripiprazole 5 mg in the morning. Hold risperidone 4 mg.
Increase aripiprazole to 10 mg. Hold risperidone. Watch for akathisia.
Increase aripiprazole to 15 mg target. Reduce risperidone to 3 mg.
Reduce risperidone to 2 mg. Hold aripiprazole.
Reduce risperidone to 1 mg. Prolactin should already be falling — counsel about possible return of menses.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: risperidone 4 mg ≈ aripiprazole 15 mg (Maudsley 14th). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
